Titel: Senior Manager CRM & Marketing Automation (f/m/d)
Unternehmen: Lumora Software GmbH
Ort: Berlin, Berlin, Deutschland
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4130281559/
Abgerufen am: 25.09.2026 07:30

About us
Lumora builds scheduling and workforce software for mid-sized service companies. More than 2,400 customers across Europe run their shift planning on our platform. We are 260 people, profitable and growing.

About the role
You will own our CRM and marketing automation stack end to end and make sure marketing and sales work from one clean source of truth.

What you will do
Own HubSpot Marketing Hub and its integration with Salesforce Sales Cloud
Design lifecycle stages, lead scoring and routing together with Sales and RevOps
Build nurture programs and onboarding journeys in four languages
Set up attribution and funnel reporting that the leadership team actually uses
Keep data quality high and GDPR-compliant consent management in place
Lead one Marketing Operations Specialist and work with an external agency

What you bring
6+ years in marketing operations or CRM management in B2B SaaS
Deep hands-on experience with HubSpot, solid working knowledge of Salesforce
Proven track record in lead scoring, segmentation and campaign automation
Strong analytical skills, SQL is a plus
Fluent English, German is a plus

What we offer
Permanent full-time contract
Salary between 88,000 EUR and 102,000 EUR per year plus virtual stock options
Remote within Germany, optional office in Berlin Kreuzberg
30 days of vacation and a yearly learning budget of 1,500 EUR

Seniority level
Mid-Senior level

Employment type
Full-time
